prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were mostly too high compared to actual noise-corrected results, except for sign_in notification where the prediction was too low.
No effect was seen for adoption redesign changes across 2 tests.
Evidence is still thin for adoption new_flow, finish new_screen, home new_flow, sign_in notification, and sign_in reorder, as each has only 1 test.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -5.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: -1.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -6.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_flow: -1.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, notification: +7.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 79.3%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 19.4%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [home, new_flow] Waiting Screen Progress Checklist Flow: Adds a live multi-step rendering checklist and an animated mascot onto the waiting screen during generation. (why: Home / waiting stage has a long mean completion time (2336s) and 3 support tickets reported custom pet rendering confusion.)
1: [choose_path, new_screen] Choose Path Welcome Onboarding Screen: Inserts a dedicated onboarding intro screen before path choice explaining ready-made versus photo-created pets. (why: Choose path drops off to 76.2% conversion and has a high mean duration of 514s due to user hesitation.)
2: [choose_path, hint] Path Decision Time Helper Hint: Adds explicit hint copy informing users that path choice is flexible and additional pets can be added later. (why: Choose path median completion time is 8s while mean time is 514s, showing a long tail of stalled users.)
3: [home, notification] Background Pet Readiness Notification: Enables system notifications on the waiting screen so users know they can minimize the app while pet generation completes. (why: Waiting stage mean time is 2336s (over 38 minutes), leading users to close or abandon the app during generation.)
4: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Estimated Time & Carousel: Displays time estimates and a tips carousel explaining desktop controls while pet generation finishes. (why: Mean time waiting is 2336s and 3 users wrote support because they did not know how to control desktop features.)
5: [adoption, layout] Upload Photos Checklist Layout: Switches the upload photos screen to a structured checklist layout with explicit photo requirements. (why: 3 support emails mentioned custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, and adoption conversion is low at 60.9%.)

scores.note: High evidence from wait time and support tickets, but historical new_flow test on home yielded -1.3% lift.
Adding a new screen adds friction, similar to prior new_screen tests (-6.0%), with no support mail backing.
Low cost copy fix for stalled users; mild positive expectation without major flow disruption.
Addresses 38-minute wait abandonment; notifications are the only change type with positive historical precedent (+7.6%).
Strong evidence from support and wait duration; informative carousel provides minor clarity without adding flow friction.
Targets the highest funnel drop-off (39.1% lost) with support mail backing, but prior adoption redesigns consistently showed negative lift (-1.3%).
